fields.Name: T324 - Routine Type Scheduled vs Monitoring Toggle
fields.Description: Exercises the RoutineType segmented control and its reactive RoutineTypeHelp text inside the advanced section — a domain concept (report-on-schedule vs watch-for-change) unique to routines.

InputDefinition.goal: In the Routines app, click 'New Routine', then expand the 'Advanced options' section (a collapsible toggle with a chevron near the bottom of the editor). Inside the Details area find the 'Routine type' segmented control with 'Scheduled' and 'Monitoring' options. Click 'Monitoring' and observe the help/hint text below the control change to describe monitoring (watch-for-change) behavior, then click 'Scheduled' and observe it change back. Success is seeing the two-option toggle switch and the accompanying help text update — you do NOT need to save.

judgeValidationCriteria: The 'Advanced options' section expands to reveal a 'Routine type' control with 'Scheduled' and 'Monitoring' options
Switching between Scheduled and Monitoring updates the descriptive help/hint text below the control
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
